description: The current NOAA National Water Prediction Service river forecast for a gauge: the forecast stage and flow series, the forecast crest with its flood category, the latest observation, flood stages and the record crest. Works for NWS forecast points (accepts the NWS id or the USGS site number). Forecasts are reissued several times a day.

site.description: USGS site number (for example "07010000" for the Mississippi River at St. Louis) or an NWS gauge id (for example "EADM7"). Use find_river_gauges to look one up.

name: get_flood_forecast
title: Get river flood forecast
